story_type: cargo plane lands and takes off on a public highway
hook: A four-engine cargo plane, landing on a public highway.
narration: This is a C-130 Hercules coming down onto a public highway in Montana.
Montana Air National Guard airmen practiced it on U.S. Highway 87 near Great Falls.
From the cockpit, the runway was a two-lane road, painted center lines and all.
Crews train for this because in an emergency, in remote places or in combat, the nearest airfield may not be usable.
The Hercules is built for it. It can set down on a short, rough strip, turn around and go again.
outcome: Then the Hercules powered up, rolled down the highway and lifted off into the Montana sky.
title: C-130 lands on a Montana highway
description:
In September 2024 a C-130H from the 120th Airlift Wing, Montana Air National Guard, practiced landing and taking off on US Highway 87 near Great Falls, Montana, during the Vigilante Landing Zone training exercise.

Footage: Montana Air National Guard video by Tech. Sgt. Nicholas Scott, 120th Airlift Wing, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/938903/vigilante-landing-zone-sizzle-reel
